name: @rulecad/frames
description: Structures from beams: a profile (aluminium extrusion of any maker, tube, angle or a printed beam) as a model from its rule set, its section as an outline, and what that section is worth as a beam beside the maker's figures. A beam of it: its mass, its anchors, the operations on it (cut, mitre, tap, access, drill, counterbore, pocket, notch, deburr) checked, and its solid as a light box or the true section. A frame's cut list (the bars to buy, packed with the saw's kerf) and a cut-and-drill sheet per beam. Slot nuts: the bought nuts by maker and kind, the nut for a face, and a printed carrier for a nut or an insert. Joins between beams by kind: the operations each puts on both beams, its screws, and its stiffness for a frame's solve. Printed fittings for those joins: a corner bracket (braced or not), gusset plates (L, T, cross) and a splice plate, drawn from the profile's and the thread's rules, keyed into the slot, sized from a named load by finite elements and reporting grams, stiffness and margin. More fittings and the guides follow.
